module.name: app:lowcode/resources/shared/page-tool-files-command
module.jsdoc:
app 的 lowcode/resources/shared/page-tool-files-command 模块。
导出 DtsTypeDeclarationModel symbol: PageToolSnapshotInput, PageToolSnapshotResult, PageToolRestoreInput, PageToolFilesDataView（共 4 个 symbol）。

assertPendingFileSavePage.title: (page: PageTool, fileName: PageToolFileName, requireActive: boolean) => void

attributes.name: pageId
attributes.jsdoc: 当前蓝图工作区中正在交付的页面身份，用于校验命令目标。

attributes.name: customPath
attributes.jsdoc: 由当前导航 DataView 解析并经应用范围校验的文件目录。

attributes.name: fileName
attributes.jsdoc: 仅允许页面工具三文件之一。

attributes.name: text
attributes.jsdoc: 当前工具编辑器读取的完整文件原文，允许空字符串。

methods.name: assertCurrent
methods.jsdoc: 在每次异步边界校验页面、节点与请求作用域仍为原目标。

methods.name: onAttempt
methods.jsdoc: 获得版本号且即将提交快照时记录可核验的文件名。

attributes.name: version
attributes.jsdoc: 经文件目录及原文回读确认的版本号。

attributes.name: requireActive
attributes.jsdoc: Whether this save requires the original page to remain the active page.

PageToolFilesDataView.name: PageToolFilesDataView
PageToolFilesDataView.jsdoc: File resource command owner; page identity and request guard are captured per command.

constructorMeta.signatureText: constructor(dataSet: DataSet, appId: string, io: FileIo, assertCurrent: () => void)

methods.name: rebindScope
methods.jsdoc: Rebind a parked command owner to a newly acquired same-project DevSystem scope.

methods.name: preflightDeletePageFiles
methods.jsdoc: Read and validate the whole page directory before another resource is mutated.

methods.name: deletePageFiles
methods.jsdoc: Delete a complete mounted page directory through the shared file command DataView.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.jsdoc:
创建发布快照是一个 file DataView 命令。版本号在 owner 内由真实目录计算；上传后同时回读目录与原文，
失败时保留 DataView 命令行及原版本号，后续保存只核验/接续这条命令。

methods.name: restoreVersion
methods.jsdoc: 将版本恢复作为原文件 DataView 命令提交；未知回执只核验原命令。

methods.name: acknowledgeRestoreDelivery
methods.jsdoc: 仅在 PageTool 已接收或明确保留本次恢复结果后消费确认回执。
